ādibrahmacariya.p: [Ādi+brahmacariya] (na) CL=7 (A) The noble practice which is first and foremost. (B) The first dhamma of the noble practice Sāsana brahmacariya which is Sāsanāto, Sīlasikkhā (practice of moral uprightness). (C) The magga practice which is noble practice that is the first and foremost dhamma of Maggabrahmacariya( one kind of moral from Khuddānukhuddaka). (D) It has the first noble practice  which is Magga. See also - Ādibrahmacariyaka. ( Sāsana means teaching (or) dispensation). (Brahmacariya means noble practice).

ādibrahmacariyaka.p: [Ādibrahmacariya+ka] (ti) CL=7 The beginner/first of Brahmacariya which is noble practice. (1) The first/beginner of the noble practice which is Magga brahmacariya that is Magga. (A) The first of Magga brahmacariya which is vinaya from Ubhato vibhaṅaḥ. (B) Ājīvaṭṭhamaka moral which should nurture at the begin of Magga brahmacariya. (C) A moral from Khuddānukhuddaka which is the start/begin of Magga brahmacariya.  (D) (Four kinds of Pārājika) Great morals Vinaya which is the start/begin of Magga brahmacariya. (E) Words which worship the three Gems(Buddha, Dhamma, Sangha) which is (the beginner practice) of Magga brahmacariya. (F) The Four Noble Truths religious meditation which is the beginner practice of Magga brahmacariya. (G) Sermon which is (place) of the beginner of Magga brahmacariya. See original. (Vibhaṅaḥ means distinguish and criticize). (Brahmacariya means noble practice). (Magga means Path/Way to Nibbana).

မြတ်သောအကျင့်-ဗြဟ္မစရိယ-၏ အဦးအစ။ （၁） မဂ်တည်းဟူသော မြတ်သောအကျင့်-မဂ္ဂဗြဟ္မစရိယ-၏ အဦးအစတရား။ （က） မဂ္ဂဗြဟ္မစရိယ၏ အဦးအစဖြစ်သော ဥဘတောဝိဘင်းလာ သိက္ခာပုဒ်။ （ခ） မဂ္ဂဗြဟ္မစရိယ၏ အစ၌ ပွါးများအပ်သော အာဇီဝဋ္ဌမကသီလ။ （ဂ） မဂ္ဂဗြဟ္မစရိယ၏ အစဖြစ်သော ခုဒ္ဒါနုခုဒ္ဒကမှ တစ်ပါးသော သီလ။ （ဃ） မဂ္ဂဗြဟ္မစရိယ၏ အစဖြစ်သော မဟာသီလ သိက္ခာပုဒ် ၄-ပါး（ပါရာဇိက ၄-ပါး）။ （င） မဂ္ဂဗြဟ္မစရိယ၏ အစ （ရှေးဦးအကျင့်） ဖြစ်သော ရတနာသုံးပါးကို ပူဇော်ကြောင်း စကား။ （စ） မဂ္ဂဗြဟ္မစရိယ၏ အစ （ရှေးဦးအကျင့်） ဖြစ်သော သစ္စာလေးပါးကမ္မဋ္ဌာန်း။ （ဆ） မဂ္ဂဗြဟ္မစရိယ၏ အစ （တည်ရာ） ဖြစ်သော တရားဒေသနာ။မူရင်းကြည့်ပါ။

ādibrahmacariyika.p: [Ādibrahmacariya+ṇika] (ti) CL=7 (1) It is the beginning of Magga brahmacariya which is noble practice that is Magga. (A) It is the beginning of Maggabrahmacariya which is  Samatha vipassanā wisdom. (B) Sammādiṭṭhi wisdom which is the beginning of Aṭṭhaṅgika-maga which has eight kinds of elements.  (C) There is four kinds of great morals which is the beginning of Magga brahmacariya. (2) It relates/compare with the beginning of Magga brahmacariya, (The practice) which is the beginning of Magga brahmacariya.  (Samatha means meditation to attain tranquality) (Vipassanā  means religious meditation).(Sammādiṭṭhi means right way of viewing things). (Brahmacariya means noble practice). (Magga means Path/Way to Nibbana).
